expect_red: sweep: pose composition is pose(t) o placement_world, against a hand-computed matrix

mutations.contract: A mesh is in its product's own local frame; `placement_world` carries it to the as-modelled assembly frame; the body pose carries that to this instant. So the matrix is pose composed ONTO placement, in that order.
mutations.note: The mutation swaps the two. It is the identity at the as-modelled point -- where every pose IS the identity, which is the frame a reviewer naturally looks at first -- and puts every body somewhere plausible-but-wrong at every other point of the sweep.
